issue.description:
ADR-002's agent-guided rehydration workflow requires a reconciliation report mapping every source identifier to a native identifier or an explicit omitted/merged/unresolved disposition, and its drawbacks state that large repositories need batching, resumable reconciliation reports, and duplicate detection — none of which has a corresponding bead. Define a versioned reconciliation-report format, document a batch/resume protocol for multi-pass rehydration in the `bead schema explain` field guide, key duplicate detection on source identifiers and external references (`bead ref`), and add a conformance fixture exercising a batched rehydration whose report carries every required disposition including explicit `omitted` entries.
